hypotheses.thesis: If VIX < 17 and SPY’s nearest 0DTE max-OI strike is within 0.4% of spot at 10:00 ET, the day’s high-low is smaller than the 20-day median.
If that magnet has already traded once by 11:00 ET, a long fly centered on it outperforms the same fly placed at 9:45 before the strike prints.
If VIX is 14–16, GEX is dampening, and call/put walls are ≤0.6% apart, close-to-magnet distance at 16:00 is tighter than on trend days with VIX > 17.
If ATM 0DTE gamma is negative but a fat positive strike sits 0.2–0.5% away, fading the hole (body at ATM) loses vs body at the fat strike.
On monthly OPEX Fridays, the 0DTE call-wall strike at 10:00 is a worse pin forecast than the strike that holds the most 0DTE gamma at 14:00.
The first session after monthly OPEX has a larger open-to-close range than the OPEX Friday itself, given similar VIX (VIX filter applied only when present).
If Friday 0DTE was all-positive gamma and Monday’s front gamma is net negative near Friday’s pin, Monday’s first 90 minutes travel farther than Friday’s first 90.
A fly placed on the OPEX pin after 14:00 beats the same fly placed at the open.
Waiting until SPY trades the intended body strike, then entering, beats entering on the first 15-minute print. Cost of waiting is a worse debit, not missed expectancy.
Sell-half-at-2x then hold the rest to 75–80% of max beats both scratch-at-2x and hold-100%-to-expiry on 0–1 DTE flies in VIX < 17.
A stop that only kills that structure (not the level) plus a second attempt at the same magnet beats one larger add after the first stop.
Two attempted 0DTE structures and done beats a third attempt the same day (expectancy of trade 3 is negative).
Put-credit under the put wall, after a one-way sell into that wall, has negative expectancy vs a long fly at the wall.
With VIX < 17 and spot above the 21-EMA, fading the first tag of the call wall without a reject print has negative expectancy.
Buying 0DTE SPY calls/puts on a dampening, VIX < 17, range day has negative expectancy vs the fly.
First-15-minute SPY direction predicts the close less often when 0DTE net gamma is positive than when it is negative.
